verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework. It documents its own programmatic surfaces: calling Proa over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby, or Java, and a core crate for adapting it to other HTTP servers or runtimes. A probe also found an OpenAPI document at proa.so/openapi.json, but nothing in the pack says what that spec covers or whether it is meant to drive the product. missing for 10: evidence of what the OpenAPI spec exposes, in-depth API reference documentation, auth and usage details for a public API, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Proa through it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
